name: Textarea
purpose: Provide headless native multi-line text entry with Field relationships and controlled or uncontrolled value handling.
useWhen: The user may enter sentences, paragraphs, notes, or other multi-line text.

avoidWhen.condition: The expected value is short and single-line.

composition: Place Textarea.Root inside one Field.Root with Field.Label and an optional description or character guidance.

rules.statement: Give every Textarea an accessible name, normally through Field.Label.
Provide a stable name when the value participates in submission.

commonMistakes.mistake: Replacing Textarea with a contenteditable div for ordinary text entry.
commonMistakes.correction: Use native Textarea unless rich-text behavior is genuinely required.

validation: Inspect the label and description relationships.
Test multi-line keyboard entry, resizing policy, and submitted value.
